summary: Splash Beverage Group, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting (1) a $217,479.24 private investment in Avicanna Inc. for 2M common shares and 1M warrants, an arm's-length strategic capital allocation with no stated price per share or premium, and (2) the appointment of Michael Bondurant as COO and revised employment terms for Interim CEO Brady Cobb (base salary $300k, performance bonuses tied to market-cap milestones). The investment is a passive minority stake, not part of a formal acquisition; the management changes are routine appointments, not forced departures. No deal terms, sponsorship, or regulatory clock apply; the filing is a material-definitive-agreement and officer-appointment update. Watch for any subsequent definitive agreement with Avicanna.
